destination: A tiny worked example: A produces a shared value, B and C each consume it independently, D joins both.
context: Ships with the plugin as the toy graph used in gbuild's own verification steps. Not a real feature.
out_of_scope: Anything beyond demonstrating fan-out and join scheduling.

acceptance.text: run dispatches B and C concurrently, not one after the other
D does not start until both B and C are checkpointed complete

nodes.title: Produce the shared value B and C both need
acceptance: writes a JSON object with a single integer field 'value' to its checkpoint output

nodes.title: Consume the shared value, produce its double
acceptance: output.doubled equals a's output.value multiplied by 2

nodes.title: Consume the shared value, produce its square
acceptance: output.squared equals a's output.value raised to the power of 2

nodes.title: Join B and C, produce their sum
acceptance: output.sum equals b's output.doubled plus c's output.squared
only runs after both b-consume-doubled and c-consume-squared are checkpointed completed
